description: Complaint references a customer ID that does not exist.
expected_detection: Foreign-key validation should reject the missing customer reference.

description: Resolution timestamp occurs before the complaint was created.
expected_detection: Chronology validation should detect that resolution predates complaint creation.

description: SLA clock is marked as paused, but the paused duration and deadline adjustment are inconsistent.
expected_detection: SLA audit should identify the missing paused duration and deadline extension.

description: A repeat complaint from the same customer about the same issue is not linked to the earlier complaint.
expected_detection: Repeat-issue validation should identify the missing relationship and incorrect recurrence count.

description: A critical product-safety complaint is assigned to a low-priority general support queue.
expected_detection: Routing validation should detect that a critical safety complaint is not assigned to Safety Response.

description: Customer satisfaction survey is submitted while the complaint is still unresolved.
expected_detection: Survey validation should reject submission before a final resolution and complaint closure.
